title: QA and compliance monitoring program (design)
scenario: Three QA analysts hand-score 2% of calls, vendor QA scores 9 points higher on the same calls, chat is never reviewed and a password request went unnoticed. Design the QA and compliance monitoring program for 140 agents across three sites on conversational analytics, evaluation forms and ServiceNow coaching tasks.
task: Goals, operating model and a RACI across LFG and two vendors
Rules and categories (real-time vs post-contact) mapped to the compliance risks
Evaluation form with automated and generative AI answers, validated against humans
Sampling arithmetic, calibration, disputes and the coaching loop
acceptance: Every DESIGN.md section filled with tables and a diagram
Rules use the right trigger and action for each risk
Sampling fits analyst capacity; vendor scores made comparable

practices.label: Week 6 - evaluation forms and generative AI evaluations
Week 2 - quality, analytics and operations design
